svg.title: Zipf's law
svg.desc: Readers request news articles labeled by popularity rank. Most requests are for top ranked articles, so they come straight back from a Redis cache that holds the top 10,000 of 100,000 articles. Only the rare request deep in the long tail goes on to the database. The bars show reads falling off as one over rank, and the totals show 10% of articles serving 81% of reads.
svg.text: 10% of the articles sit in the cache, and they catch 81% of the reads.
